text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
The "Arima Kinen"... It's finally here, 
Trainer-kun. Our first major battle 
against the previous generation.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
There were several chances to compete in 
the past. However...

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Only on such a grand stage could this 
serve as the opening ceremony.
choice_data_list:
Looks like they're coming at us seriously 
too.

Looks like they're coming at us seriously 
too, huh.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. Special Week and Grass Wonder. Just 
as promised, both of them came without 
fail.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
I have to respect that courage. Still, the 
winner is going to be me!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Opera O-san, the day of our showdown is 
finally here!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Please, don't worry about us. We are fully 
prepared to keep a watertight guard.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
F-Fufufu, kukuku... Such momentum... And 
not a single opening...

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
That's so like you two. That's what makes 
it worth surpassing you. The twin pillars 
of the previous generation, Grass-kun and 
Spe-kun.
T.M. Opera O turned toward the fans—

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: Hear me, audience who love Umamusume!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
"Today, for the first time, I stood upon 
the stage of the 'Arima Kinen.'"

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Previous generation vs. Current 
generation. To sound the opening bell of 
our war!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
"And to serenade those who built the 
golden age with a song of appreciation and 
finality!"

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
From here on... the moment the gates open, 
the shining sun shall set, and an 
everlasting night shall descend upon 
Nakayama Racecourse.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
The darkness of battle runs deep, and the 
hour before dawn is always the darkest. 
However...

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
No matter how gruesome a battle is waged, 
none shall sleep until it is settled. 
None...

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
And— I'm the one who'll win with the break 
of dawn!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Come, my people, bear witness! To the dawn 
of a new era!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Come, predecessors of this era. Let us 
proceed to the stage of our fateful 
encounter!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Allllriiiight!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: —I'd like nothing more.

Spurred on by T.M. Opera O's provocation, 
flames ignited in both of their eyes.

From the Supreme Ruler of her generation 
to the End-of-Century Supreme Ruler of all 
generations. T.M. Opera O's true battle 
begins!
